description.en: The long (H) block of the 9 mm miniature linear guide: 20 mm wide, 39.9 mm long, with four M3 tapped holes on a 15 × 16 mm pattern on top. It mates its rail from below and a carriage part on top.
description.es: El bloque largo (H) de la guía lineal miniatura de 9 mm: 20 mm de ancho, 39.9 mm de largo, con cuatro barrenos roscados M3 en un patrón de 15 × 16 mm en la parte superior. Se une a su riel por abajo y a una pieza de carro por arriba.
description.fr: Le patin long (H) du guidage linéaire miniature de 9 mm : 20 mm de large, 39,9 mm de long, avec quatre trous taraudés M3 sur un motif de 15 × 16 mm sur le dessus. Il s'accouple à son rail par-dessous et à une pièce de chariot par-dessus.
description.pt: O bloco longo (H) da guia linear miniatura de 9 mm: 20 mm de largura, 39,9 mm de comprimento, com quatro furos roscados M3 num padrão de 15 × 16 mm em cima. Acopla ao trilho por baixo e a uma peça de carro por cima.

sources.title: HIWIN linear guideways MG series — dimensions for MGN/MGW
VORON Design sourcing guide, sheet 'VORON 2.4' (the published Google sheet behind vorondesign.com/sourcing_guide, gid 1297316004)
sources.supports: Linear Rail MGN9H (the H block) for the 2.4's MGN9 rails

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the top mounting face (the face with the four M3 holes). +z up, out of that face; +x along the rail (the block's long direction); +y across. The rail's top face lies 3.5 mm below the top face (H 10 − rail height 6.5), so the rail interface sits at z = −3.5.

assembly_height.note: H: rail bottom to block top

rail_width.note: HIWIN WR: the channel the block straddles

interfaces.note: Female: tapped holes receive the fastener's thread. Symmetry 2: the 16 (along) × 15 (across) pattern is a rectangle, so it repeats only at a half turn.
Female: the block receives the rail. z = −3.5 is derived from H 10 − HR 6.5.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P6-GANTRY lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

solids.note: the block over the rail: top face down to the rail's top
the +y skirt beside the rail, down to H1 = 2 above the rail's bottom (z = -(10 - 2))

envelope.note: The MGN9H block as three boxes that leave the 9 mm rail channel open, so a block on its rail does not overlap it (as mgn12h-carriage). End seals are inside the 39.9 mm length.
